name: Lynn Canyon Ecology Centre Volunteer
org: District of North Vancouver, Lynn Canyon Ecology Centre
what_you_do: Help keep Lynn Canyon Park clean (age 10+) or provide support during the spring and summer mini-camps for kids (age 13+).
who_can_apply: Park clean-up age 10 and up (10 to 14 with an adult). Mini-camp assistant age 13 and up. School field-trip assistant is 18 and up.
pay_detail: Unpaid. Volunteers get a free pin, a yearly certificate and a membership discount.
duration: Mini-camp: at least one full camp. Clean-up: up to 1 hour a week.
deadline_text: The page says 2026 summer mini-camps are at capacity for volunteers. It says applications get a reply within 10 business days. No ongoing-acceptance statement.
how_to_apply: The 2026 summer mini-camps are at capacity for volunteers. Fill in the online volunteer form on the page and choose the position.
notes: The page does not say whether applications are accepted on an ongoing basis. A police check is not stated on the page we read.
